periods.summary: Gedronika possesses China as a bloodline vessel, transforms her appearance and begins spreading black absolute-zero cold through Odaiba while explaining her immortal body-replacement method.
periods.cause: China's dragon blood and weakened state create a coordinate for Gedronika's arrival.
periods.process: Black snow and cold emanate from China; Gedronika reveals herself, reads memories and drives her tail into the ground to start disaster attack.
periods.outcome: Tokyo faces an expanding freezing catastrophe unless the tail/attack is stopped.
periods.significance: Reveals Gedronika's true nature and the volume title's Ultra Plinian catastrophe.
